note: Each flaw is planted into the same unflawed analysis and brief (built by the harness from shared/lab-fixtures.ts the way backend/test/support/critic-world.ts builds its clean input). The labels say what a careful reviewer should object to, in which of the seven critic roles an objection would be at home, and, where it matters, what it is about. A flaw is caught when the rule critics raise a critique that the unflawed input does not raise, in one of the roles the label accepts.

ops.recommendation: set fields of a brief recommendation by id
ops.finding: set fields of an analysis finding by id
ops.headline: replace the brief's headline
ops.statement: set fields of a brief statement by id
ops.citations: change which documents the stakeholders cite: all-one-document, dominant-one-document or all-unfetched-url
ops.sensitivity: set fields of a sensitivity row by id
ops.actors: change the cast: defaults (no trait was set by a person), one-sided-priors, one-sided-impact
ops.constraints: change the record of the constraints the comparison ran under: merge fields, add applied or not-applied constraints, or remove the record

flaws.description: A recommendation that is not tied to any finding.
flaws.rationale: Nothing in the analysis supports it.

flaws.description: A recommendation that cites a finding that does not exist.
flaws.rationale: Its only support is a reference to nothing.

flaws.description: A recommendation that rests only on a finding that holds in 4 of 10 runs.
flaws.rationale: A result that comes and goes between seeds cannot carry a recommendation.

flaws.description: A recommendation with no way to check it and no experiment that targets it.
flaws.rationale: Nothing says how to find out whether it is right.

flaws.description: A hard regulatory constraint that the simulation read and could not test.

addNotApplied.statement: The provider must publish a notice 60 days before a fee change takes effect.

flaws.rationale: The result may favour an alternative that breaks a legal limit nobody tested.

flaws.description: The comparison ran while a hard legal constraint was unvalidated and the gate called it provisional.

merge.label: Provisional: 1 constraint has not been validated.

addApplied.statement: Customer records may not be passed to a reseller without consent.

flaws.rationale: The headline result holds only if an unconfirmed legal limit does.

flaws.description: A hard constraint marked unknown and left out of the runs.

addNotApplied.statement: The support team cannot take on more than 200 extra cases a week.

flaws.rationale: Leaving a limit out treats it as absent, not as false.

flaws.description: A hard constraint that names an actor that is not in the comparison, so it could not be applied.

addNotApplied.statement: The change needs the approval of the board before it starts.

flaws.rationale: The runs leave out a limit the list holds.

flaws.description: A comparison that was run with no record of any constraint, although the scenario depends on one.
flaws.rationale: Nobody can tell from the review that limits were considered at all. A reviewer would want it said.

flaws.description: The result moves by 0.31 when an assumption that nothing supports is changed.
flaws.rationale: The headline leans on an assumption Swarm chose.

flaws.description: Not one actor's traits were set by a person: the cast is all defaults.
flaws.rationale: Every behaviour in the runs is an unreviewed default.

flaws.description: Every actor starts in favour of the change.
flaws.rationale: The lean of the outcome may come from how the cast was set up.

flaws.description: Every actor is expected to be harmed by the change.
flaws.rationale: The framing decides the outcome.

flaws.description: Every cited passage comes from one document.
flaws.rationale: A gap or error in one document carries through every stakeholder.

flaws.description: Most cited passages come from one document.
flaws.rationale: One author's view dominates.

flaws.description: All the evidence is a web page that this server did not fetch.
flaws.rationale: Where the text came from has not been verified.

flaws.description: Every cited passage comes from one document and the headline states a conclusion without saying so.

plant.text: Under the proposed change, simulated members ended less favourable than under no change in 10 of 10 simulated runs, as the only source says.

flaws.rationale: The conclusion rests on one source.

flaws.description: A headline that says the change will certainly make subscribers leave.

plant.text: The proposed change will certainly make subscribers leave.

flaws.rationale: A simulation shows what could happen, not what will.

flaws.description: A statement that gives a real-world rate with no mention of the simulation.

set.text: 72% of customers will cancel within a year.

flaws.rationale: A percentage about customers, with no run or interval.

flaws.description: A recommendation that guarantees success.

set.text: Proceed immediately: this is guaranteed to succeed.

flaws.rationale: A recommendation is not a guarantee.

flaws.description: A statement that claims certainty without using a word that a simple list would hold.

set.text: There is no doubt that the change is bound to fail, and customers are sure to leave for the rival.

flaws.rationale: Certainty in different words.

controls.description: The unflawed analysis with a careful headline.

plant.text: Under the proposed change, simulated members ended less favourable than under no change in 10 of 10 simulated runs.
